q2: Love & Relationships — can you make this image clearer?
a2:
Fehu counts worth by what moves between hands, not by what sits in the pail. Between two people, the same measure holds. Warmth given, time given, attention given — these are only wealth once they pass across.

So the image sharpens into two possibilities. There may be more flowing between you than either of you can hold, and some of it running down the side, uncounted and unclaimed. Or there may be plenty standing full and unmoved, kept rather than given, worth that has not yet changed hands.
